title: Add error message for unsupported cross-cluster query

timeline.message:
Add error message for unsupported cross-cluster query

Return `ES|QL does not yet support querying remote indices`
for cross-cluster queries until the feature is implemented.
timeline.author: Nhat Nguyen

timeline.body:
Return `ES|QL does not yet support querying remote indices` for cross-cluster queries until the feature is implemented.

Closes #102650
We probably should also fail these empty queries, but I don't think we should spend time on it.

Nit: we could show which index patterns are not supported, eg. 

```
"ES|QL does not yet support querying remote indices [*:events*]"
```

timeline.author: Nhat Nguyen
